Mixed Brands
Blank Audio Cassette Tape Lot - Type I & Type II High Bias
25 Sealed Tapes
This comprehensive lot of vintage blank audio cassette tapes includes 25 individual tapes from leading manufacturers including TDK, Maxell, Memorex, Sony, and Fuji. The collection features a variety of tape types, primarily High Bias Type II formulations designed for CD recording and high-fidelity music reproduction, as well as standard Type I Normal Bias tapes. 275002137.description:
Glass Insulator Lot - 3 Pieces
Hemingray and American Manufactured
Aqua Teal and Clear, Vintage Mid-Century Era
This collection of three vintage glass insulators represents a significant era in American telecommunications history. Used primarily to insulate telegraph and telephone wires from their wooden support poles, these heavy glass pieces are prized by collectors for their industrial aesthetic and vibrant glass colors. This lot provides a balanced display including a classic aqua teal piece and two clear glass specimens.
Pieces Included:
Hemingray Insulator, Aqua Teal Glass, embossed "HEMINGRAY" with beaded drip points - minor base fleabites
Clear Glass Insulator, embossed "MADE IN U.S.A.", smooth base - excellent vintage condition
Unmarked Clear Glass Insulator, smooth base - excellent vintage condition
Condition:
The lot is in very good vintage condition. The teal Hemingray insulator shows typical minor chipping and roughness along the drip points on the base, which is characteristic of utility-grade glass. The clear insulators are notably well-preserved with no significant chips or cracks. All pieces retain their original glossy transparency without signs of glass disease or mineral cloudiness.

274588323.description:
You are purchasing a "Sheaffer Prelude Black Fountain Pen with Case Pre-Owned" in "Used" condition.
Elegant Sheaffer Prelude fountain pen in classic black with gold-tone trim, complete with its original red presentation case. This pen has a timeless, refined look that feels at home in a boardroom, on a desk, or as a special gift. The black body and cap are accented by bright gold-tone details, including the clip, cap band, and nib section. The nib is clean and ready for ink, and the pen includes a converter so you can fill it from bottled ink rather than being limited to cartridges. The original red case with white interior adds a vintage, sophisticated touch and makes this a great presentation or gift item. If you enjoy smooth writing instruments with a classic design and quality feel, this Sheaffer Prelude is a standout choice and a stylish addition to any collection.
